```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import html
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np


HERE = Path.cwd()
manifest = json.loads((HERE / "report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
samples = manifest.get("samples", [])


def load_qa(sample):
    path = HERE / sample["result_dir"] / "qa.json"
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return {}


def show(value, unit=""):
    if value is None or value == "":
        return "—"
    if isinstance(value, float):
        if not math.isfinite(value):
            return "—"
        text = f"{value:.4g}"
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        text = " × ".join(show(item) for item in value)
    else:
        text = str(value)
    return html.escape(f"{text} {unit}".strip())


def summary_line(label, contents):
    return f'<div class="compact-line"><strong>{html.escape(label)}</strong>: {contents}</div>'


def info_line(contents):
    return f'<div class="compact-line">{contents}</div>'


qa_reports = [load_qa(sample) for sample in samples]


def pipeline_rms(qa):
    background = qa.get("pipeline_background", {}) or {}
    return background.get("rms_jy_per_beam", qa.get("vla_background_rms_jy_per_beam"))


rms_values = [
    float(pipeline_rms(qa))
    for qa in qa_reports
    if pipeline_rms(qa) is not None
    and math.isfinite(float(pipeline_rms(qa)))
]

print(f"<h1>{html.escape(str(manifest.get('title', 'VLA sample imaging report')))}</h1>")
print(f'<p class="report-description">{html.escape(str(manifest.get("description", "")))}</p>')
print('<div class="report-summary">')
print(f"<strong>Processed samples:</strong> {len(samples)} / {show(manifest.get('total_samples'))}")
print('<div class="section-label" style="margin-top:0.5rem">Background RMS</div>')
if rms_values:
    print(summary_line("Mean", show(float(np.mean(rms_values)), "Jy/beam")))
    print(summary_line("Median", show(float(np.median(rms_values)), "Jy/beam")))
    print(summary_line("Std", show(float(np.std(rms_values)), "Jy/beam")))
else:
    print(summary_line("Mean", "—") + summary_line("Median", "—") + summary_line("Std", "—"))
print("</div>")

if rms_values:
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 2.5))
    ax.hist(rms_values)
    ax.set_xlabel("VLA background RMS [Jy/beam]")
    ax.set_ylabel("Samples")
    plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha="right")
    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
else:
    print('<p class="explanation">Background RMS histogram unavailable.</p>')

for sample, qa in zip(samples, qa_reports):
    parameters = qa.get("effective_imaging_parameters", {})
    metrics = qa.get("metrics", {})
    residual_metrics = metrics.get("residual", metrics) or {}
    geometry = parameters.get("measured_geometry", {})
    beam = geometry.get("beam", {})
    result_dir = str(sample["result_dir"]).rstrip("/")
    mask_nbeams = parameters.get("mask_nbeams")
    mask_text = (
        f"central circle | diameter={show(mask_nbeams)} synthesized beams"
        if mask_nbeams is not None
        else show(parameters.get("mask"))
    )

    parameter_lines = [
        info_line(f"deconvolver={show(parameters.get('deconvolver'))} | nterms={show(parameters.get('nterms'))}"),
        info_line(f"specmode={show(parameters.get('specmode'))} | gridder={show(parameters.get('gridder'))} | stokes={show(parameters.get('stokes'))}"),
        info_line(f"weighting={show(parameters.get('weighting'))} | robust={show(parameters.get('robust'))}"),
        info_line(f"imsize={show(geometry.get('imsize', parameters.get('imsize')))} px | cell={show(geometry.get('cell_arcsec', parameters.get('cell')))} arcsec"),
        info_line(f"mask={mask_text}"),
        info_line(f"niter={show(parameters.get('niter'))} | nsigma={show(parameters.get('nsigma'))} | threshold={show(parameters.get('threshold'))} | cycleniter={show(parameters.get('cycleniter'))}"),
        info_line(f"beam={show(beam.get('major_arcsec'))} × {show(beam.get('minor_arcsec'))} arcsec | PA={show(beam.get('position_angle_deg'))} deg"),
    ]
    metric_lines = [
        info_line(f"residual RMS = {show(residual_metrics.get('rms_jy_per_beam'), 'Jy/beam')}"),
        info_line(f"sigma = 1.4826 × median(|residual − median(residual)|) = {show(residual_metrics.get('scaled_mad_jy_per_beam'), 'Jy/beam')}"),
        info_line(f"residual absolute peak = max(|residual|) = {show(residual_metrics.get('residual_abs_peak_jy_per_beam'), 'Jy/beam')}"),
        info_line(f"residual minimum = min(residual) = {show(residual_metrics.get('residual_min_jy_per_beam'), 'Jy/beam')}"),
        info_line(f"residual maximum = max(residual) = {show(residual_metrics.get('residual_max_jy_per_beam'), 'Jy/beam')}"),
        info_line(f"peak / sigma = max(|residual|) / sigma = {show(residual_metrics.get('peak_over_scaled_mad'))}"),
        info_line(f"p99 / sigma = P99(|residual|) / sigma = {show(residual_metrics.get('p99_over_scaled_mad'))}"),
        info_line(f"p99.5 / sigma = P99.5(|residual|) / sigma = {show(residual_metrics.get('p99_5_over_scaled_mad'))}"),
        info_line(f"DR (RMS) = global max(clean image) / selected residual RMS = {show(metrics.get('dynamic_range_rms'))}"),
        info_line(f"robust DR = global max(clean image) / selected sigma = {show(metrics.get('dynamic_range_scaled_mad', metrics.get('dynamic_range')))}"),
        info_line(f"VLA Pipeline background RMS = non-PB-corr noise-annulus RMS = {show(pipeline_rms(qa), 'Jy/beam')}"),
    ]
    if qa.get("warnings"):
        metric_lines.append(info_line("warnings = " + "<br>".join(html.escape(str(item)) for item in qa["warnings"])))

    print('<div class="sample">')
    print('<div class="sample-info">')
    print('<div>')
    print(f'<div class="sample-id">{html.escape(str(sample.get("id", "—")))}</div>')
    print(f'<div class="ms-path">{html.escape(str(sample.get("ms_path", "—")))}</div>')
    print('</div>')
    print('<div>' + "".join(parameter_lines) + '</div>')
    print('<div>' + "".join(metric_lines) + '</div>')
    print('</div>')
    print('<div class="sample-images">')
    for filename, caption in (("dirty.png", "Dirty"), ("clean.png", "Clean"), ("residual.png", "Residual")):
        source = html.escape(f"{result_dir}/{filename}", quote=True)
        print(f'<figure><a href="{source}" target="_blank" title="Open full-size {caption}"><img src="{source}" alt="{caption}"></a><figcaption>{caption}</figcaption></figure>')
    print('</div>')
    print('</div>')
```
